message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in European populations**

| Population (gnomAD v3.1) | Minor allele (C) frequency | Major allele (T) frequency |
|--------------------------|----------------------------|----------------------------|
| European (non‑Finnish)   | **≈ 0.12** (12 %)          | ≈ 0.88 (88 %)              |
| Finnish                  | ≈ 0.10 (10 %)              | ≈ 0.90 (90 %)              |

*The C allele is the minor allele and corresponds to the APOE ε2 allele; the T allele is the major allele (ε3/ε4).*

These figures come from the gnomAD database (v3.1) and are consistent with 1000 Genomes Phase 3 data, where the C allele frequency in Europeans is reported around 0.11–0.13. The frequency can vary slightly among sub‑European groups but generally stays within the 10–13 % range.
